committed_trace_review.finding: Committed Qwen3 trace evidence covers attention bias absence for 28 layers only; feed-forward and output-head role events are missing from this pre-SLM-CPU-185 trace.

Committed Qwen2.5 trace evidence proves attention q/k/v bias tensors are present for 24 layers, so any future no-bias selector must be per-role and fail closed for those roles; feed-forward and output-head role events are still missing from this pre-SLM-CPU-185 trace.

manifest_capture_status.reason: No committed post-SLM-CPU-185 strict CPU trace artifacts contain complete model_init.linear_bias_finish role records for every required attention, feed-forward, and output-head role across both Qwen3 and Qwen2.5 Q8_0.

missing_evidence.why_required: Feed-forward gate/up/down roles must have positive bias_present true/false evidence per layer before any no-bias selector can consider those roles.
The exact Qwen3 output-head mode and bias policy must be explicit before any output-head no-bias decision.
Feed-forward gate/up/down roles must have positive bias_present true/false evidence per layer before any no-bias selector can consider those roles.
The exact Qwen2.5 output-head mode and bias policy must be explicit before any output-head no-bias decision.
Any future selector proof must bind behavior-preserving receipts to the exact manifest artifact and SHA.
Before/after receipts must prove whether the no-bias selector was disabled, enabled, or declined and preserve generated IDs/text.
